code:
$ git checkout 544cda6 -- \
    data/raw/customers.csv.dvc
$ dvc checkout
M  data/raw/customers.csv
# customers.csv -> 1000 rows

$ git checkout main -- \
    data/raw/customers.csv.dvc
$ dvc checkout    # -> 1200 rows
